reviews.review: Great game ! Similar vibes to Division 2 and good repeatability at higher difficulties.

The connection is total...ARSE (A-S-S). If you play with players, there's a probability chance that the game will "kick" you off. This causes you to "lose connection with host", in which case could be either your connection is bad, the host's connection is bad (or their hacking is making the connection bad), or the servers are just too laggy to play. What's worse is that should this ever occur, your challenge card will be count as "used". Yes: you can lose your challenge card if you lost connection to host!

With that aside, the only good thing is the level ups. Oh, the campaign maps? Just 12, in total. And they're short. Should've made more maps, yeah? And I don't mean the DLC ones.
The best game I have ever played.

What people don't expect from one of the world's largest game companies with 100,000 programmers...

Let's be honest - if you really want to kick the aliens' asses after Alien Isolation (the game from 1979^^) - welcome to 1986 with reference to the newer films.

If you look at the company website, you'll see that the team doesn't even have 50 people.
This is a solid arcade shooter game. Of course it could be so much more and that's exactly the point. The game is excellent in what it does and invites you to dream about what else would have been possible if this had been a really big game company.
The last time I had similar thoughts I was playing Space Hulk: Deathwing. However, the comparison is flawed because there really is a replay value here, which for me was completely missing from Space Hulk.

I would like to see a part 2 with randomly generated systems, stations and battles in the future. As I said, what is available invites you to dream and is a no-brainer, especially during sales.

I would love to play this game more, but I can't recommend it as a co-op game (the "intended" playstyle) because my friends always get disconnected and this seems like a massive issue that the community is experiencing. The game is a ton of fun, but I ran the very first mission 6 or 7 times before me and my friend were able to complete it without him getting disconnected. We're now unable to complete the second mission without him getting disconnected. It's just not acceptable, so I can't recommend the game right now. I'll edit this review if this changes.
